g.text: Fantasy and war dominate board games
They make up nearly 30% of all board games, but just about 10% of the top 100 ranked titles.
common in the top 100 than among
board games overall but scarce in
Categories reflect community-assigned board-game categories, not gameplay mechanics. Formats were excluded, and overlapping or overly specific labels were excluded in
favour of broader categories. Percentages are normalized separately for each group, showing relative preference rather than total volume.
Each bar shows how often a category appears across games.
Percentages are normalized separately for each group.
